items.description:

items.headline: Flood Watch issued August 1 at 1:08PM AKDT until August 7 at 12:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is possible.

* WHERE...The following areas, Central Susitna Valley, Lower
Matanuska Valley, Southern Susitna Valley and Western Susitna
Valley.  This includes the cities of Palmer, Wasilla, Big Lake,
Skwentna, Willow, Talkeetna, Trapper Creek, And Petersville.

* WHEN...From Tuesday morning through Friday morning.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.

* ADDIT

items.headline: High Wind Warning issued August 1 at 12:57PM AKDT until August 5 at 4:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 30 to 50 mph with gusts up to 70 mph expected.

* WHERE...Windy Pass.

* WHEN...From 10 PM Sunday to 4 AM AKDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult. Gusty winds could blow around
unsecured objects. Tree limbs could be blown down and a few power
outages may result.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Heat Advisory issued August 1 at 12:28PM AKDT until August 1 at 9:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Hot temperatures as high as the mid 70s.

* WHERE...Interior Kenai Peninsula, Skilak Lake, and Turnagain Pass.

* WHEN...Until 9 PM AKDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Individuals not accustomed to these unusually hot
temperatures for this region may experience heat related illnesses.
items.areas: Skilak Lake; Interior Kenai Peninsula; Turnagain Pass
items.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids and check up on elderly and vulnerable
relatives and neighbors.

Young children and pets should never be left unattended in vehicles
under any circumstances as vehicle interiors can reach extreme
temperatures in as little as 10 minutes.
